items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Art Tatum in the context of a story about Oscar Peterson and Jerry Wiggins, but Lee Young does not describe a personal interaction or relationship with Art Tatum.

ctx.x: was like unwritten, but the guy that -- the Lightweight would start off first, and he would play a while, and so they're drinking beer. And so another guy would touch him and he would get up; then he would play.

Now they all are gonna play so they can get to El Presidente, you know, who was Art, and after the 3 of them would play, Art would sit there and drink beer a little while, and he'd get over and he'd jump up to the piano and say Breeee deeee doo. But he was unreal.
Did anyone ever tell you the story about Oscar Peterson jamming with Art Tatum, the first time he met Art Tatum up at Jerry Wiggins' house?
